answer: Require each agent to lock a bond that vests slowly, then score identities by behavioral correlation: when a cluster attests, votes and goes idle in near-lockstep, the protocol treats it as one actor, pays it a single reward share and slashes every bond in the cluster. Like quartz grains fused into basalt, clones merge into one mesa of stake. An attacker running N fakes pays N bonds yet earns one share, so Sybils lose money.
